headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak linked to tainted jalapenos isn’t over, as CDC reports more than 400 cases
headlines.description: The CDC reported more than 400 cases in 32 states, although the number of illnesses is likely to be much higher.

headlines.title: Trump nominates Heidi Overton to lead FDA
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is expected to nominate physician Dr. Heidi Overton, a White House aide, to be his new FDA commissioner.

headlines.title: Merck and Moderna say cancer vaccine shows signs of preventing recurrence of melanoma
headlines.description: Pharmaceutical giants Moderna and Merck said that an experimental vaccine treatment has shown signs of preventing cancer from returning or spreading in a study of high-risk melanoma patients. NBC News health reporter Aria Bendix explains what happens next.

headlines.title: Favorite Gadgets and Gear to Boost Your Personal Wellness
headlines.description: There are plenty of fun gadgets to boost your personal wellness so NewBeauty senior editor-at-large Sarah Eggenberger joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to share her favorites. Products include a digitized jump rope, Therabody smartgoggles for top tier relaxation, and more.

headlines.title: How to Keep Your Skin Healthy During the End of Summer
headlines.description: The end of summer can be rough on skin, so board-certified dermatologist Marnie Nussbaum stops by TODAY to share ways to keep your skin health and looking good. Tips include exfoliating once or twice a week, using the ABCDE rule to determine if a sunspot is cause for concern and more.

headlines.title: Costco Enters Medicare Market With Limited Launch
headlines.description: Costco is rolling out its own Medicare plans in a partnership with health insurer, Scan. The deal calls for a limited launch of Medicare advantage plans in two states, along with a Medicare supplement in a third.

headlines.title: This Rubbermaid container keeps food fresh, supplies organized and your pantry looking neat — it’s $12 today
headlines.description: Rubbermaid’s popular food storage container with a snap-to-close lid, is one sale for more than 25% off on Amazon. It’s perfect for dry foods like grains and more.

headlines.title: Bogg Bag vs. Owala, Away, Yeti and Simple Modern: Which brand has the most durable beach bag?
headlines.description: We tested multiple popular beach bags, including the Bogg Bag, and compared it with competitors from Owala, Simple Modern and more.

headlines.title: The best styling products to keep flyaway hairs at bay
headlines.description: Our editors spent three months testing hair styling products to keep flyaways, baby hairs and frizz at bay. Shop the best options from Dae, Briogeo, Fenty Beauty and more.

headlines.title: Tick prevention for dogs: Vets explain how to beat the blood-suckers
headlines.description: Dogs are more vulnerable to Lyme disease than ever. These are the best vet-approved tick preventatives for dogs and how to check your dog for ticks.

headlines.title: New CDC director pledges to ‘speak truth’ about science
headlines.description: Dr. Erica Schwartz addressed CDC employees Wednesday in her first agencywide meeting.
